reserveReview.rationale: Pinned Ethereum block 26285175 (hash 0xa86483d8286713b73125b62e640f380b17af4c93a34cfd452f6bed94f27e9e4d, timestamp 2026-10-27T16:14:35Z) reconciles eight registered facilitator bucket levels (Core 135,000,000; Plasma 50,000,000; mainnet GSMs 310,000,000; Lido 45,000,000; Horizon 59,000,000; Arbitrum 50,000,000; Monad 50,000,000; FlashMinter 0) to the 699,000,000 GHO totalSupply. The facilitator registry still lists the same eight addresses. The reviewed address-book GSMs report positive getUsed plus getCurrentBacking excess: stataUSDT $61,233,895.327762 (used 61,230,772.260462 plus excess 3,123.0673) and stataUSDC $0.034817. Both are unfrozen and unseized. Module identities (Aave receipt claims on USDC and USDT, not idle issuer-token custody) are those verified at block 26088256 and were not re-resolved at this block. The adapter attributes measured claims only to their mainnet parent and retains the uncovered balance as unknown; the $248,766,104.637421 uncovered mainnet allocation cannot be resolved to further issuers from these reads. Weights are recomputed from this block; the stataUSDT claim rose from $18,999,688.174487 at block 26088256.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Same-block Ethereum facilitator bucket levels, totalSupply and tracked GSM getUsed/getCurrentBacking at block 26285175; adapter-derived parent-local issuance attribution
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Mainnet residual and remote Arbitrum/Monad issuance together remain 49.895007816512% unresolved at the constituent level. These are research surfaces, not proven issuer-specific holdings. Measured GSM holdings are linked; unmeasured submodule allocations are withheld. Issuer questionnaire pending.
